measures.name: _CF RI Bar Color
measures.expression: SWITCH(TRUE(), [MS Realization Index] >= 150, "#1D9E75", [MS Realization Index] >= 100, "#5DCAA5", [MS Realization Index] >= 50, "#EF9F27", "#E24B4A")

measures.name: _CF Strength Badge BG
measures.expression: SWITCH([MS Customer Strength Badge], "Champion", "#EAF3DE", "Above average", "#E1F5EE", "Below average", "#FAEEDA", "Growth target", "#FCEBEB", BLANK())

measures.name: _CF Strength Badge Text
measures.expression: SWITCH([MS Customer Strength Badge], "Champion", "#27500A", "Above average", "#085041", "Below average", "#633806", "Growth target", "#791F1F", BLANK())

measures.name: _CF Mix Index BG
measures.expression: SWITCH(TRUE(), [MS Mix Index] >= 150, "#EAF3DE", [MS Mix Index] >= 80, "#E6F1FB", [MS Mix Index] >= 1, "#FAEEDA", "#FCEBEB")
